parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 with all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb to 0.8635. This is my new best. Next, I'll experiment with halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to allow for more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, as others have seen gains there.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
